name: Cerecinos del Carrizal (Spain)
description: A blue hoist third bearing a white dove, the fly of five horizontal stripes of green and yellow.
history: The arms and municipal flag were approved by the full council of Cerecinos del Carrizal in its session of 3 December 2004; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of two vertical stripes in proportions 1/3 and 2/3, blue with a white dove at the hoist and five equal horizontal stripes, three green and two yellow alternating, at the fly.

features.role: five stripes of green and yellow on the fly
